def max_accordion_length(s):
    open_bracket = s.count('[')
    close_bracket = s.count(']')
    colon = s.count(':')

import re

def max_accordion_length(s):
    # Define the regex pattern for an accordion
    pattern = r'\[\:([|]*):\]'
    
    # Find all non-overlapping occurrences of the pattern
    matches = re.findall(pattern, s)
    
    # Check if there are any matches
    if not matches:
        return -1
    
    # Calculate the maximum length of the matches
    max_length = max(len(match) + 4 for match in matches)
    
    return max_length

def max_accordion_length(s):
    open_bracket_count = s.count('[')
    close_bracket_count = s.count(']')
    colon_count = s.count(':')

    stack = []
